original_content_full: The paper entitled "CodeCV: Mining Expertise of GitHub Users from Coding Activities" written by Daniel Atzberger, Nico Scordialo, Tim Cech, Willy Scheibel, Matthias Trapp, and Jürgen Döllner is accepted for publication on the International Working Conference on Source Code Analysis and Manipulation (SCAM 2022). The conference is co-located with the ICSME and will be held in Limassol, Cyprus from October 3-4. For more information, please refer to https://www.ieee-scam.org/2022/.
